reason: A DSH Web client plugin that visualizes estimated instantaneous tokens-per-second in the active task status line, with lifecycle-aware visibility and hover fade behavior; the README states it uses session snapshots and makes no network calls.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 的任务状态行中显示基于会话快照估算的实时瞬时 TPS，并随任务状态和悬停行为调整显示效果。
summaries.en: Displays an estimated instantaneous TPS rate in the DSH Web task status line and adjusts its visibility based on task state and hover behavior.

capabilities: Displays an estimated real-time TPS badge in the DSH Web status line
Reads session snapshots to derive the displayed rate
Applies client-side UI visibility and hover behavior
Makes no network calls according to the README
